name: State Farm
verdict: State Farm Mutual is a mutual company; its annual report is addressed to its policyholders. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: State Farm Mutual Automobile Insurance Company, parent of the State Farm companies, is a mutual company; its 2025 annual report is addressed to its policyholders, and its members may attend the annual meeting (first named insured with the right to vote). No state or state-fund stake in that structure.
